summary: Agentic robotics systems combine planners with robot harnesses to perform complex manipulation tasks. Recent work improves these systems through better harnesses and external memory, but relies on powerful closed-source models as planners and does not improve the planners' own capabilities.
takeaways: In contrast, coding agents have improved substantially by post-training the model itself.
To this end, we introduce AgenticRoboRL, a framework for post-training robot planners across different harnesses.
The training recipe combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-turn reinforcement learning.
